name: ProgramPathwayExplorer
tagline: Turn programme browsers into enquiries – find, check entry, compare and request info.
description: A recruitment-ready programme finder for universities, colleges and training providers on Power Pages, Canvas and Model-driven apps: rich filters, domestic/international fees, entry-requirement checks against the applicant's results, career outcomes, study pathways, side-by-side comparison of up to four programmes and a validated request-for-information form that outputs JSON for your lead process.
features: Search across programmes, careers, modules and prerequisites
Level, faculty, mode, campus, intake, fee and duration filters with six sort orders
Entry check: Meets / Close / Below with near-miss margins and pathway suggestions
Careers tab with salary bars and Pathway tab with articulation chain
Compare 2–4 programmes with best-value highlights and differences-only
Request-information form with validation and consent, output as JSON
Responsive side panel, tablet dialog and phone bottom sheet
